decisions.reason: A niche reusable citrus crate fits the firm's existing crate tooling and costs little to keep listed, and with no evidence since 2019 its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
The foldable large container kept a dedicated page in both observed years, which signals continued commitment in a growing reusable-packaging segment and argues against abandonment.
A stackable crate is a core, low-cost line extension for a plastic packaging maker, so keeping it costs little and its value is likely to be realized.
The medium-duty rackable pallet sits in a broad pallet range at low marginal cost and has stayed consistently visible, so there is no signal yet that its value will not be realized.
The spill-retention pallet was downgraded from its own page to a mention, a mildly negative signal, but it fills a regulatory niche and is cheap to keep, so the option is retained.
The pallet with load retainers also lost its own page, which hints at weaker prospects, yet uncertainty remains and holding costs are low, so it is kept for now.
